description: Deep research, web searching, summarizing articles/papers, fact-checking, and long-term memory retrieval.
routing_rules: Assign when looking up public facts, searching the web, or synthesizing multiple information sources.

tools.name: net_search
tools.description: Queries web search engines to retrieve relevant search snippets, titles, and URLs.

tools.name: net_fetch
tools.description: Executes high-speed HTTP requests with custom headers and response inspection.

tools.name: net_weather
tools.description: Retrieves live weather data and meteorological forecasts.

tools.name: research_calculate
tools.description: Performs safe, in-process mathematical calculations (fractions, percentages, statistics) for research data.

tools.name: research_extract_keywords
tools.description: Extracts key technical terms, entities, and frequent topics from research texts or article snippets.

tools.name: research_format_citations
tools.description: Formats raw research URLs, titles, and snippets into standard bibliography citations.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Searches stored memory facts and user profile using semantic vector retrieval.

tools.name: memory_store_fact
tools.description: Stores a new episodic fact, research note, or user preference in long-term memory.

tools.name: youtube__get_transcript

tools.name: youtube__get_video_info

tools.name: youtube__search_videos
